facts.material: hybrid polyester/epoxy resin powder with pigments (proportions unknown)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3208 (paints and varnishes based on synthetic polymers dispersed or dissolved in a non-aqueous medium) vs 3210 (other paints and varnishes) vs 3907 (epoxy/polyester resins in primary forms); chapter 32 note 1 and 4 read
GRI 6: subheading depends on the predominant polymer (3208.10 polyesters vs 3208.90 other, e.g. epoxy) and whether any medium is present

rejected_alternatives.reason: only if polyester predominates and the product is in a non-aqueous medium; not established
other paints and varnishes; possible for a dry powder with no medium
resin in primary forms; the product is a formulated pigmented coating

missing_facts: Which resin predominates by weight, polyester or epoxy, and in what proportion?
Is the powder dispersed or dissolved in any medium, or is it dry powder only?
Does it contain pigments or fillers, and in what amount (is it a finished coating or a resin intermediate)?
classification.rationale: The 6-digit subheading depends on the dominant polymer (polyester vs epoxy) and on whether the product is a coating in a non-aqueous medium or a dry powder. The description supplies neither. Searches returned no usable ruling, so none is cited.
